original.target_description: Comparison of product size judgments under high versus low color saturation.; full original paper not acquired within allowed routes/time.

replication.target_description: Hagtvedt and Brasel (2017), high versus low saturation, laptop screen size; Japanese online adult sample

n.sample_role: Japanese online participants included in final analysis
n.exclusions: 247 excluded for failing instructional manipulation check and attention check question, as reported; paper says recruitment opened for 1000 although 823 + 247 differs.
n.quote: Finally, the data of 823 participants (mean age = 40.77, SD of age = 10.48, 428 males, 391 females, 4 did not prefer to say) were analyzed.

reported_success.quote: No studies involving visual factors, between-participant manipulation of senses, or interactions between factors could be replicated.

notes: Reported success is the authors’ study-level narrative verdict.
